snippet.title: American Gladiators (NES) Gameplay 240p | No Commentary - Gametek, Oct 1991 (Original Hardware)
snippet.description:
American Gladiators was released for Nintendo's classic 8-bit NES console in October 1991. All audio/visual elements copyright 1991, Gametek. Music composed by Leif Marwede.

https://nesguide.com/games/american-gladiators/

This video was produced for NESguide.com - a website that attempts to organize the NES catalog and make it easy to explore. Gameplays from this channel are featured throughout the NESguide website to showcase the original basic mechanics and audio/visual design of each title. Thank you for your continued support of this project, since 2007!


ABOUT AMERICAN GLADIATORS (NES)

As in the real show, the player use their strength and stamina in order to confront their opponents and the American Gladiators. Players must navigate through the Assault, Powerball, Human Cannonball, The Wall, and Joust over a course of four increasingly difficult skill levels. If you succeed against all difficulty levels (and odds), you will face the Eliminator. When you defeat the Eliminator, you have achieved the ultimate victory (at least in American Gladiators).
